current.company_description: Sip & Scale is a community built around one simple idea: the best opportunities often start with a conversation.We bring together founders, operators, students, creatives, developers, and curious minds through curated dinners, intimate gatherings, and activity-based events. In a world where most networking feels transactional, we're creating spaces where relationships come first. Some people come to meet the co-founders. Some come to learn from experienced operators. Others come to find friends who share the same ambition and curiosity. Many leave with all three.What started as a small dinner series has grown into a global network spanning 25+ cities, connecting thousands of people across technology, startups, AI, design, investing, and beyond.Our community is made up of people who are generous with their knowledge, open to new ideas, and willing to help others succeed. Whether you're launching your first startup, exploring a new career path, building side projects, or simply looking to meet exceptional people, Sip & Scale is where meaningful connections happen.We're not building another networking group.We're building the community we wish existed when we started.Learn more at sipnscale.com
current.description: - organising events for good convos between founders, builders and investors

current.company_description: Last semester we raised +40M, had 9 dropouts, and sent 5 kids to YC. Why are you just now hearing about us? We used to be called called Life Changing Labs, named after and sponsored by the non-profit. But LCL shut down recently, so we had no reason to keep our name. Also we used to be "underground" — we did no marketing. However, now we want to make entrepreneurship mainstream at Cornell, so expect to see more of us : ) Part of popularizing & unifying entrepreneurship at Cornell means being open to everybody. We host weekly Startup Hours every Thursday @ eHub collegetown 7:30 - 9:00PM. We cater FREE Chipotle or Dos Amigos. Sometimes we bring speakers like YC, a16z, etc backed founders or billionaires. SIGN UP - we pub weekly Startup Hours sign up links on our IG, website, and the Cornell Entrepreneurship Email List Serv (recommend joining!)  Our goal is to make entrepreneurship more prevalent at Cornell by sharing our resources with EVERYBODY not gatekeeping them for just our E-Board. Reach out if we can help with anything!
current.description: - i get cracked speakers to come share at cornell
current.name: Cornell Entrepreneurship Club
current.title: Events

past.company_description: The Raspberry Pi Foundation is a UK-based charity with the mission to enable young people to realise their full potential through the power of computing and digital technologies.Our visionOur vision is that every young person develops:• The knowledge, skills, and confidence to use computers and digital technologies effectively in their work, community, and personal life; to solve problems and to express themselves creatively• Sufficient understanding of societal and ethical issues to be able to critically evaluate digital technologies and their application, and to design and use technology for good• The mindsets that enable them to confidently engage with technological change and to continue learning about new and emerging technologiesOur long-term goals1. Education: To enable any school to teach students about computing and how to create with digital technologies, through providing the best possible curriculum, resources, and training for teachers.2. Non-formal learning: To engage millions of young people in learning about computing and how to create with digital technologies outside of school, through online resources and apps, clubs, competitions, and partnerships with youth organisations.3. Research: To deepen our understanding of how young people learn about computing and how to create with digital technologies, and we use that knowledge to increase the impact of our work and advance the field of computing education.
